d: A suspected mass shooting plot targeting a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois, has raised fresh concerns over anti-Indian hate crimes in the United States. Prosecutors allege that 19-year-old Alexandros Paporakis planned the attack, but his rifle malfunctioned and a co-worker alerted police. The incident has drawn concern from India’s Ministry of External Affairs and renewed scrutiny of racism, religious intolerance and the safety of Indian-American communities.
